title: St. Moritz, Graubünden — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to St. Moritz, Graubünden: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

St. Moritz is a city in Graubünden with a population of 5,000. The world-famous Alpine resort in the Engadin valley, host of two Winter Olympics, known for its luxury hotels, frozen lake polo, and the legendary Cresta Run. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
